question: A positively charged rod is brought near (without touching) a neutral, isolated metal sphere. What is the nature of the electrostatic force on the sphere, and why?

options.A: Always attractive, because induced charges make the near side negative and the far side positive.
options.B: Always repulsive, because the sphere contains positive charges.
options.C: Zero, because the sphere is overall neutral.
options.D: Attractive only if the sphere is earthed (grounded).
